notes.title: V1.23 FPS Fix and Other Changes
notes.notes:
Hello again Defenders, good news, you can have more frames now. 

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Previously after about the 5th wave or so there was a noticeable and consistent lag spike, I've done some  digging to find the cause of the issue and I have done some tuning, unfortunately it can't be completely removed as it would completely destroy any gameplay that exists, however it only becomes a problem now FAAAR into a run in the Labyrinth. 
[*] I have also made it so you can now Deselect Defences and Guard Summoning Stones by essentially Selecting anywhere on the Screen that doesn't involve User Interface.
[list]

notes.title: V1.22 Upgrading Returns (Fix) and Other Changes
notes.notes:
Hello again Defenders! Apologies for the delay but I return with good news that news consisting of a few fixes for you all along with a few other tweaks coming in the next few days, I also greatly appreciate the feedback received recently, hopefully there may be a few thumbs up when these tweaks arrive.

[h1]Steam Cloud Saves are now available![/h1]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] A fix for the inability to Upgrade Defences while in the Labyrinth past a certain point has been put in place and now works as intended.
[*] After going beyond Wave 5 a Button with an exclamation mark in it would appear at the top of the screen which when selected it should have shown the current modifiers on the Enemies, but would not show at all, this has now been fixed and works as intended.
[*] Summoning and the Healing of Guards now works as intended.
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] A fix for the inability to Upgrade Defences while in the Labyrinth past a certain point has been put in place and now works as intended.
[*] After going beyond Wave 5 a Button with an exclamation mark in it would appear at the top of the screen which when selected it should have shown the current modifiers on the Enemies, but would not show at all, this has now been fixed and works as intended.
[*] The navigation for the paths has been narrowed slightly to make any Scrolls that drop a little easier to select.
[*] After selecting the 'Understood' Button on a Tutorial they would continue to appear whenever the condition for them to appear was met, now they will only appear if they have not appeared before OR if you reset Tutorials by re-enabling them if necessary.
[*] Paths Maximum Length have been reduced by 20%.
[*] The scaling for the Enemy Count of each wave has been reduced by slightly.
[*] All Enemies now deal a slightly reduced amount of Damage to Guards.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.21 Scroll Finder and Other Changes
notes.notes:
Hello there Defenders of Klondor! A few changes and additions for you all.

[h1]Mechanics[/h1]
[list]
[*] While in the Labyrinth a Dropped Scroll List appears that helps you narrow down whether there are scrolls in the Level and where they are, by using the output of entries that display the distance between each Scroll and the Player.
[*] A new Cursor Speed setting has been added to the Settings Menu. 
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Scrolls that drop are now higher above the ground and the hitbox has been make smaller due to Scrolls blocking other interactable objects.
[*] Reduced the Mana Usage of Heal for the Guards from 25 to 10.
[*] Reduced the Mana Usage of Revive for the Guards from 50 to 20.
[*] Reduced the Maximum Base Health of the Fire and Ice Golems by 25.
[*] Reduced the time that dropped Scrolls exist for from 20 seconds to 10 seconds.
[*] The Loading screen between the Town and the Labyrinth is no longer a blinding light and has been swapped to something gentler on the eyes. 
[*] Scrolls now suggest "Select to Pickup" since Right Clicking to Pickup may be a little difficult on a controller. 
[*] Tips that are shown on Loading Screens are now fed from a Data Table instead of an Array.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.2 - Controller Support and Other Changes
notes.notes:
It's been a while but a new Update is coming your way!

[list]
[h1]Mechanics[/h1]
[*] Debuff Rework - Debuffs don't simply just deal damage over time or reduce movement speed, they can now be stacked and cancelled out by other Debuffs but not at a complete loss as Thermal Shock can now be used to increase the damage of the next hit by alternative Element Types.

[*] Controller Support - Controllers can now be used in conjunction with Mouse and Keyboard no setting changes required just plug in a Controller and away you go!

[*] Guards can no longer have their Weapon Classes changed.

[*] Tutorials have also undergone a Rework in an attempt to optimize and streamline their use.

[*] Tutorials should now fit nicely in the game window without them escaping from the Viewport as before they weren't scaling to the resolution of the screen whereas they do now.
[/list]

[list]
[h1]Optimizations[/h1]
[*] The overhead Memory cost for widgets within the Labyrinth have been reduced - Before this Update each individual Guard Summoning Stone and Defence had their own widget assigned to them whereas now there is just the one Widget for all of the previously mentioned things.
[/list]

[list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[*] Spells were gaining bonus stats from Masteries for Defences now they gain bonuses from their appropriate Mastery Types.

[*] A fix has been put in place to deter overlapping of UI within the Labyrinth as before the Defence and Spell selection windows would overlap the Mana and Crystal Health Bars.

[*] The Glowing Materials that Enemies would have after being given a Debuff no longer exist and have been replaced with Particles that represent whether they are Burning or Freezing.
[/list]
